name: Egerbacher
beschreibung: The Gasthof Egerbacher is located in a quiet location on the edge of the village in Tirol, surrounded by meadows and forests, with views of the surrounding mountains. The surroundings are ideal for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The rooms are simply and solidly furnished, some with a balcony. At the heart of the house is the traditional guest parlour with a tiled stove, supplemented in summer by an outdoor dining area. The kitchen offers regional dishes from Tirol based on local products. The atmosphere is family-friendly and relaxed, and the target group is primarily active holidaymakers and families.
